scientific_integrity: The claimed contribution is the four-run height-bounded weighted enumeration. Standard individual-word side-distance formulas, binary height/minimality equality, and non-isolated-run formulas are explicitly attributed to prior literature. The proof handles all positive run lengths, including singleton interiors.
scientific_limitations: No extension beyond binary four-run words is claimed. The all-parameter enumerator is a relatively short enumerative specialization of established piecewise-height methods. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: A perfect-square length enumerator for bounded piecewise height of four-run binary words
